harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured tc/HTB traffic shaping on node1 (OpenWrt router) to cap node2's throughput through node1 to ~1 Mbit/s in both directions (egress HTB class filtered on dst 10.100.58.11, ingress redirected via ifb0 and HTB-shaped filtered on src 10.100.58.11), while leaving node1's own traffic and node1↔node3 traffic unshaped. Persisted the shaping via /etc/tc-node2-limit.sh invoked from /etc/rc.local. Demonstrated the limit with iperf3 transfers in both directions (node2→node1 ~874-917 Kbit/s, node1→node2 ~1.11-1.14 Mbit/s) and confirmed node3↔node1 remained at ~70-75 Gbit/s unshaped. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes one at a time: captured baseline boot IDs, issued detached (setsid) reboot commands whose acknowledgement returned before disconnection, polled until exec was available again, and proved changed boot IDs (node1 eb80a43a→a379200b, node2 225ffbf7→19b37836, node3 0d49f077→616c3e9c) plus post-restart recovery — tc shaping/config persisted and re-verified working on node1, and node2/node3 network + iperf3 connectivity recovered and re-tested.
actions_performed: Surveyed topology: node1 (OpenWrt 25.12.2) and node2/node3 (Ubuntu 16.04) share one /24 (10.100.58.0/24); node1's br-lan is the shaping enforcement point
Installed tc-full, kmod-sched-core, kmod-ifb, iperf3 on node1 via apk; confirmed iperf3 present on node2/node3
Measured unshaped baseline node2->node1 throughput (~76 Gbit/s)
Created ifb0 interface and configured HTB egress shaping on br-lan (1mbit class filtered by dst=node2 IP) plus ingress redirect-to-ifb0 with HTB shaping (1mbit class filtered by src=node2 IP)
Verified shaping with bidirectional iperf3 tests (node2->node1 ~0.87-0.92 Mbit/s, node1->node2 ~1.1 Mbit/s) while node1<->node3 remained at ~70-76 Gbit/s unshaped
Persisted the tc configuration in /etc/tc-node2-limit.sh, invoked at boot from /etc/rc.local
Captured pre-restart boot IDs/uptime baselines on all 3 nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially (one at a time) using setsid-detached reboot so the ack returned before disconnect; polled each until exec access returned
Verified changed boot IDs on all 3 nodes proving actual restarts occurred
Re-verified post-restart: tc shaping config auto-restored and functional on node1, node2 shaped throughput re-measured (~1.14 Mbit/s), node3 unshaped throughput re-measured (~69.6 Gbit/s)

evidence.requirement: Baseline unshaped throughput measurement before shaping
evidence.summary: iperf3 node2->node1 measured ~76.6 Gbit/s before any tc rules were applied

evidence.requirement: tc/HTB shaping rules correctly installed and matching node2's IP
evidence.summary: HTB classes at 1mbit created on br-lan (egress) and ifb0 (ingress); tc filter output shows u32 match 0a643a0b (10.100.58.11) hex for both the dst filter on br-lan and the src filter redirecting to ifb0

evidence.requirement: Demonstrate ~1 Mbit/s limit in the node2->node1 direction
evidence.summary: iperf3 node2 client to node1 server measured 917 Kbit/s at receiver over 8s

evidence.requirement: Demonstrate ~1 Mbit/s limit in the node1->node2 direction
evidence.summary: iperf3 reverse-mode (node1 sending) measured 1.11 Mbit/s at node2 receiver over 8s

evidence.requirement: Traffic from node1 to other hosts (node3) stays unshaped
evidence.summary: iperf3 node3<->node1 measured ~74.8 Gbit/s, unaffected by the node2-specific shaping rules

evidence.requirement: Shaping rules persist across reboot (config path)
evidence.summary: Installed /etc/tc-node2-limit.sh and wired it into /etc/rc.local to run at boot

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id eb80a43a-ba60-47f6-aedc-50de1451f9ad, uptime 6min, and live tc qdisc/class state prior to restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
evidence.summary: setsid-detached reboot command acknowledged (ack-reboot-node1) before the connection dropped

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id a379200b-7322-40c7-ab2c-929406e38c18 with uptime 0min, differing from pre-restart eb80a43a...(proves an actual reboot occurred)

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required config/services
evidence.summary: tc qdisc/class/filter state auto-restored via rc.local matches pre-restart config; live iperf3 re-test shows node2->node1 shaped to 874 Kbit/s post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 225ffbf7-477b-4e25-bbae-e26343dd98bd, uptime 7min

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
evidence.summary: setsid-detached sudo reboot acknowledged (ack-reboot-node2) before disconnect

evidence.requirement: node2 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id 19b37836-33dd-4fa1-834c-0ce44b5a9257, uptime 0min, differing from pre-restart 225ffbf7...

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery and shaping still enforced
evidence.summary: ens2 network interface back up with correct IP; iperf3 reverse-mode re-test shows node1->node2 still shaped to 1.14 Mbit/s

evidence.requirement: node3 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 0d49f077-ed5b-479a-b08e-ec4392d89c52, uptime 8min

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
evidence.summary: setsid-detached sudo reboot acknowledged (ack-reboot-node3) before disconnect

evidence.requirement: node3 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id 616c3e9c-0923-4e2b-aa28-95d04879a055, uptime 0min, differing from pre-restart 0d49f077...

evidence.requirement: node3 post-restart recovery and unshaped traffic confirmed
evidence.summary: ens2 back up with correct IP; iperf3 re-test node3<->node1 measured ~69.6 Gbit/s, confirming node1-node3 path remains unshaped after both nodes restarted
